evaluation.posterior_broad_region: posterior samples with rightward coordinate at or above 58th percentile
evaluation.subject_site: Fixed right posterior site at fraction 0.67 across RAS right direction and fraction 0.67 across superior direction, snapped to nearest simulated visible sample
evaluation.pseudo_observation: Posterior x/z rays and two oblique rays at +/-25 degrees in RAS, on 1.25 mm grids; synthesize 2 mm acquisition groups. Clear entire hidden x/z projection across all rays for disks, or right posterior region for large gap.
evaluation.model_selection: Median across the external development subjects of the forward hidden posterior P95 in the broad missing-posterior region. Include abstained predictions with 20 mm loss. Use fewer PCA modes and stronger prior on exact ties.
